title: Unilateral perpetual check: the checking side loses at the third occurrence
rationale: The rook alternates d5 and e5, checking the general after every Red move, while the general shuttles d10 and e10 and never attacks anything. The in-check position stands at plies 0, 4 and 8; on the third the violation is complete and the side giving the checks loses. The outcome names the violator, never the side to move at detection.
